newsitem.title: GERMANY: Merck KGaG acquires license for new bone product.
newsitem.headline: Merck KGaG acquires license for new bone product.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group Merck KGaA said on Thursday it has acquired the license to sell a new substance designed to replace bones which is expected to be launched in 1999.
Merck acquired the license for the product, Alpha BSM, a patented substance developed by U.S. group Etex, based in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
Merck said the market for such products is growing and that its unit Merck Biomaterial will be involved in sheparding the product through clinical development in Europe.
The company did not say how much it paid for the license or how its will impact its results.
